description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains related to streaming, including producer and consumer grains, observer classes, and subscription management for testing streaming functionalities within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: StreamItem
classes.description: Represents a stream item with data and stream ID.

classes.name: ConsumerObserver
classes.description: Implements an asynchronous observer for stream items, managing stream subscription and message handling.

classes.name: ProducerObserver
classes.description: Implements a producer observer that can produce items sequentially, in parallel, or periodically, and manages timers and stream publishing.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages multiple producer observers, capable of producing streams in sequence, parallel, or periodically, and supports state persistence.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ProducerGrain
classes.description: A persistent variant of the producer grain that saves its state.

classes.name: Streaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages multiple consumer observers, capable of subscribing to streams and aggregating consumption metrics.

classes.name: PersistentStreaming_ConsumerGrain
classes.description: A persistent variant of the consumer grain that saves its state.

classes.name: Streaming_Reentrant_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain combining producer and consumer functionalities.

classes.name: Streaming_ProducerConsumerGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages both producer and consumer observers, enabling bidirectional streaming.

classes.name: Streaming_ImplicitlySubscribedConsumerGrain
classes.description: An implicitly subscribed consumer grain for testing implicit stream subscriptions.

classes.name: Streaming_ImplicitlySubscribedConsumerGrainBase
classes.description: Base class for implicit stream subscription consumer grains.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic for grains, initializing state and dependencies.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream producer for a specific stream.

methods.name: ProduceSequentialSeries
methods.description: Produces a sequence of stream items in order.

methods.name: ProducePeriodicSeries
methods.description: Produces stream items periodically using timers.

methods.name: GetItemsProduced
methods.description: Returns the number of items produced.

methods.name: AddNewConsumerGrain
methods.description: Adds a new consumer grain to the stream.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Configures the grain as a stream consumer.

methods.name: GetItemsConsumed
methods.description: Returns the total number of items consumed.

methods.name: GetConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active consumers.

methods.name: StopBeingProducer
methods.description: Stops the grain from producing stream items and disposes timers.

methods.name: VerifyFinished
methods.description: Verifies that all stream activities are completed and observers are disposed.

methods.name: StopBeingConsumer
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming streams and clears observers.

methods.name: RenewProducer
methods.description: Reinitializes the producer with a new stream provider.

methods.name: RenewConsumer
methods.description: Reinitializes the consumer with a new stream provider.

methods.name: DeactivateProducerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the producer grain when idle.

methods.name: DeactivateConsumerOnIdle
methods.description: Deactivates the consumer grain when idle.
